description: This file implements the RemotePlugin class for a Rust adapter in a plugin framework, handling socket communication, process management, and JSON-RPC message handling.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A class implementing a remote plugin interface for communication with a Rust backend, managing socket streams, process launching, and JSON-RPC message handling.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up socket communication, and optionally spawns a remote process.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, closes socket, and waits for remote process to terminate.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::SendTo
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC invocation, sending invoke messages over the socket.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Activate
methods.description: Activates the plugin (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the plugin (no-op in this implementation).

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel and sends an attach message.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel and sends a detach message.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages, returning JSON-RPC factory or logging unimplemented.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Close
methods.description: Closes a channel (no-op in this version).

methods.name: RemotePlugin::Validate
methods.description: Validates a token and method (stub implementation).

methods.name: RemotePlugin::onRead
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is read from the socket, forwarding JSON messages.

methods.name: RemotePlugin::LaunchRemoteProcess
methods.description: Launches a remote process with specified shared library, IP, and port.
